# Figma MCP Design System Review Checklist

Please complete this checklist for every Figma-driven change before requesting review:

- [ ] Followed the required MCP integration flow (see CLAUDE.md §8, Figma Integration Workflow)
- [ ] Used get_code and get_screenshot for all implemented nodes
- [ ] Reused design system color tokens, typography, and components
- [ ] Replaced Tailwind classes with project utilities/tokens
- [ ] Validated UI for 1:1 look and behavior against Figma
- [ ] Ran through CLAUDE.md §8.6's Validation Checklist for this PR

---

Refer to [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) for full process and implementation standards.
